note: FullCalendar integrates the FullCalendar.io v6 JS library as a Views style plugin, id 'fullcalendar' (@ViewsStyle, title 'FullCalendar', config schema views.style.fullcalendar). Requires core views + datetime and the drupal/fullcalendar_io library. No configure route; the calendar is configured entirely in a View's Format settings. It defines a FullcalendarOption plugin type (manager plugin.manager.fullcalendar, dir Plugin/fullcalendar/type, alter hook fullcalendar_type_info), one permission 'update any fullcalendar event', four hooks (hook_fullcalendar_classes[_alter], hook_fullcalendar_droppable, hook_fullcalendar_process_dates_alter), and two AJAX routes (fullcalendar.update at /fullcalendar/ajax/update/drop/{entity_type}/{entity}; fullcalendar.results at /fullcalendar/ajax/results/{view}/{display_id}). The single source of truth for 'is this a FullCalendar display' is a View display's display_options.style.type == 'fullcalendar'. Medium reads the style plugin id of a known View; hard creates a View that uses the fullcalendar style, verified live. Fixture views are namespaced fc_*.

evals.prompt: How do I turn a Drupal View into an interactive calendar using the fullcalendar module? What is the Views style plugin id, and which core modules must be enabled?
evals.expected_output: In the View's Format section choose the 'FullCalendar' style (Views style plugin id 'fullcalendar'). It requires core Views and Datetime enabled, and pulls in the FullCalendar.io library (drupal/fullcalendar_io).

evals.prompt: What permission does the fullcalendar module define, and what does it allow?
evals.expected_output: It defines 'update any fullcalendar event', which lets a user edit/move (drag-and-drop reschedule) any calendar event, ignoring other entity edit permissions.

evals.prompt: The fullcalendar module lets other modules extend it. Name a hook it invites for altering event CSS classes, and the plugin type / annotation it defines for contributing calendar options.
evals.expected_output: Hooks include hook_fullcalendar_classes() and hook_fullcalendar_classes_alter() (plus hook_fullcalendar_droppable() and hook_fullcalendar_process_dates_alter()). It defines the FullcalendarOption plugin type (manager plugin.manager.fullcalendar, discovery dir Plugin/fullcalendar/type) for contributing calendar option handlers.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a View with the machine name fc_events. Inspect the live View configuration and tell me which Views style (row/format style) plugin its default display uses.
evals.expected_output: The fc_events View's default display uses the Views style plugin 'fullcalendar' (display_options.style.type = fullcalendar).

evals.prompt: This site has a View named fc_agenda that renders content as a calendar. Inspect the running site and name the Views style plugin id used by its display.
evals.expected_output: fc_agenda uses the 'fullcalendar' Views style (display_options.style.type = fullcalendar, with the list view enabled).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a View with the machine name fc_cal that lists content (nodes) and uses the FullCalendar module's Views style to display them as a calendar. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a View fc_cal whose display uses the fullcalendar Views style (display_options.style.type = fullcalendar). Verify requires a display on fc_cal with style type 'fullcalendar'.

evals.prompt: Build a calendar View on this site with the machine name fc_sched: it should list nodes and use the fullcalendar Views style. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a View fc_sched with a display whose style type is 'fullcalendar'.
